name: Canva Websites
description: Canva Websites is Canva's no-code website design and publishing product for responsive pages, Canva-hosted or custom domains, privacy controls, and website insights inside the same Canva account and content library.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Canva Websites connection or install. Connect the canonical Canva provider once for bounded generic design discovery. Relay does not create, edit, publish, unpublish, configure, or analyze Canva Websites because Canva's stable Connect API does not expose a website preset, website-specific design type, publication, domain, privacy, or insights contract.

blocked.label: Create a separate Canva Websites connection
blocked.description: Canva Websites uses the same Canva user, team, OAuth grant, Projects library, and design APIs as the canonical Canva provider; a second connection would duplicate identity and authority.

blocked.label: Install duplicate Canva Websites tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported generic design metadata actions once through the canonical Canva provider rather than publishing parallel Websites tools and policies.

blocked.label: Create or edit Canva Websites
blocked.description: Canva's stable Create design presets do not include websites, and Relay does not expose website pages, content, navigation, responsiveness, SEO, privacy, or arbitrary editor operations.

blocked.label: Publish or configure Canva Websites
blocked.description: Publishing, updating, unpublishing, Canva-hosted URLs, custom-domain purchase or attachment, DNS, redirects, passwords, search visibility, mobile settings, and access controls are blocked.

blocked.label: Read insights or administer websites
blocked.description: Website Insights, traffic, visitors, engagement, domains, subscriptions, billing, teams, permissions, deletion, raw APIs, and browser automation are outside the bounded Canva connector.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Canva
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Canva Websites action is enabled because Websites shares the canonical Canva provider and lacks a stable bounded website automation contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate Canva Websites tools are mounted. OpenClaw may use canonical Canva for bounded generic design metadata, but website-specific actions remain unavailable.
No duplicate Canva Websites tools are mounted. Hermes may use canonical Canva for bounded generic design metadata, but website-specific actions remain unavailable.

providerSetup.blocker: Canva Websites is a Canva design product, not a separate provider identity or authorization surface. A second provider card, OAuth grant, credential record, installation, policy, or runtime adapter would duplicate the existing Canva connection. Canva's current stable Connect API lists websites as designs in the shared content library but does not offer a website preset or stable website creation, content editing, publication, domain, privacy, redirect, or insights endpoints; unsupported design classifications may resolve to unknown.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this product-mode slug non-installable and direct account connection and bounded generic design discovery to the canonical Canva provider. Do not use canva_design_create as a substitute for website creation. Revisit only if Canva publishes stable, public-review-eligible website design types and typed creation, editing, publication, domain, privacy, analytics, rollback, and deletion APIs, and Relay approves their exact customer authority and data contract.

evidence.supports: Canva defines Websites as designs inside the same Canva content model and user Projects library rather than as a separate provider resource system.
Canva's stable Create design endpoint offers doc, email, presentation, and whiteboard presets but no website preset; stable design type metadata likewise has no website value and may return unknown.
Canva describes Websites as a drag-and-drop product with templates, Canva or custom domains, privacy controls, mobile optimization, and Website Insights.
Canva documents website publication, Canva-hosted and custom domains, domain verification, search visibility, password protection, page paths, metadata, and analytics as product workflows.
Canva publishes one Connect API integration model for designs and related content, with public integrations subject to review and preview APIs excluded from public review.
